limitations.note: The agent registered the output but compared the post-shift value, so match still asserted and cleared one clock edge earlier than the reference, which compares the pre-shift value of a_tem.
The test advanced expected to the post-shift state before checking match, so it validated the agent's timing assumption and would reject the correct one-cycle-delayed output.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation script to be rejected before it ran, so the agent had to resubmit the test using a different temporary-directory wrapper.
The search surfaced a related registered comparison, but it did not inform the agent's choice of whether to compare the pre-shift or post-shift state.
